name: Arcane beam
desc: A beam fires right from the hand: a white core, strands twisting round it, pulses running down it, a flaring source and an end that sprays sparks.

name: Arcane missiles
desc: A volley of violet bolts fans out of the hand, curls round on twisting ribbons and pops on the target one after another.

name: Arcane orb
desc: A floating orb of smoky violet glass with a swirl turning round a white-hot heart, two tilted rings of light orbiting behind and in front.

name: Blink in
desc: Glittering bits spiral in to a point of light that opens into a line, then into a white silhouette that cools into the caster.

name: Blink out
desc: The caster crackles with gathering light, flashes white, squeezes into a line of light that collapses and pops away in sparks.

name: Magic circle cast
desc: A circle draws itself on the floor, runes ignite one by one, it flashes, and a column of light fires up and breaks apart into glints.

name: Mana burst
desc: Energy rushes into a point and blows out in a white flash and rings, flinging glowing runes that flare and pop into sparks one after another.

name: Portal
desc: An upright rift: fibrous spiral arms wind down into the dark, a lit rim wobbles, motes and streaks are pulled in, the floor glows.

name: Rune circle
desc: A rune circle turns on the floor in perspective: a carousel of runes lit by chasing light, a turning square, ticks, motes rising off it.

name: Spell charge
desc: Energy gathers in the caster's hand: streaks and motes spiral in, rings collapse into a swelling orb that crackles with arcs, ready to fire.

name: Star fall
desc: Stars streak down on long trails across an area, each landing with a white flash, a ring across the floor and a kick of sparks.

name: Time stop
desc: A clock face springs open, ticks slower and slower, freezes drained of colour, cracks, then shatters into falling shards.

name: Bat
desc: A bat flaps in four snappy wing frames along a figure-eight, its body lifting on each downbeat, moonlight on its wing bones, red eyes glowing and glinting.

name: Bird
desc: A songbird flies in place: bursts of wingbeats that lift its body on each downstroke, a glide on spread wings, its tail fanning, a loose feather drifting away.

name: Butterfly
desc: An iridescent butterfly wanders a loop in bursts of quick wingbeats and open-winged glides, its veined, spotted wings shedding a twinkling trail of glowing dust.

name: Eyeball
desc: A bloodshot eyeball floats in its fleshy lids: its glowing iris snaps from one look to the next, it blinks, and its nerve sways behind it as it bobs.

name: Fish school
desc: A school of fish holds station in two depth rows: bodies wag into swinging tails, one darts ahead now and then, bubbles rise and caustic light ripples over them.

name: Flying skull
desc: A cracked bone skull bobs in the air, jaw chattering, eyes burning, a fire roaring off its crown that sheds flame puffs, embers and smoke and throws warm light.

name: Frog
desc: A frog puffs its throat, blinks, crouches and leaps to snap a buzzing fly out of the air, then lands with a squash and a puff of dust, gulps and settles.

name: Ghost
desc: A sheet ghost bobs over the floor: its scalloped hem ripples and trails its drift, little arms flutter, it glances about and blinks, motes trickle off its hem.

name: Jellyfish
desc: A see-through jellyfish pulses: its bell squeezes to shove it up and relaxes as it sinks, frilled arms and long tentacles trailing, a glow inside, bubbles drifting by.

name: Slime
desc: A glossy slime hops in place: it squashes to wind up, stretches into the jump, rounds out in the air, splats down flinging droplets that creep back, then wobbles and blinks.

name: Snake
desc: A snake slithers along the floor, head raised: humps rise and roll back down its patterned body to the tail, dust puffs where it touches down, its forked tongue flicks.

name: Wisp
desc: A will-o'-the-wisp loops a figure-eight over the floor: a little soul-flame with a face, its flame tail licking up and streaming behind, shedding puffs and sparks.

name: Barrel explosion
desc: An explosive barrel shudders, its lid bulging and spitting flame, then blows: a fireball column, staves and the lid flying, burning fuel splashed over the floor.

name: Big explosion
desc: A huge ground blast in three beats: a white dome, a rolling fireball that climbs into a mushrooming smoke column, heavy rocks, and fires left burning.

name: Cartoon POW
desc: A comic-book hit: a jagged two-tone burst star slams in with a shake and boiling edges, POW! drops in letter by letter, action lines fly, then it all snaps away.

name: Dirt explosion
desc: A buried charge goes off: a flash under the floor, a V of dirt clods and grit thrown high, a brown dust plume that billows and settles, and a crater left behind.

name: Firework burst
desc: A shell climbs, slows and bursts into a sphere of coloured trailing stars round a gold core; they droop, crackle into white pops and fade, leaving glitter.

name: Firework rocket
desc: A rocket fizzes off the ground on a sparkling gold trail, coasts, and bursts into a palm: heavy gold fronds arc out, droop on glittering trails and crackle at the tips.

name: Grenade
desc: A grenade is lobbed in, bounces, rolls to a stop with its fuse fizzing, shudders, then blows: a white flash, shrapnel streaks, sparks, a small fireball and a scorch.

name: Implosion
desc: Everything is sucked in: streaks and grit rush inward, rings contract and a dark sphere collapses onto a crushed white point; a beat of stillness, then a sharp pop.

name: Nuke
desc: A blinding white frame, then a fireball lifts on a thin stem into a wide rolling cap that glows from inside; a white skirt flashes and a dust surge sweeps the floor.

name: Plasma explosion
desc: A blue-violet energy blast with no smoke: a white flash, a ball of plasma swelling into a thinning shell, shock rings in and out of depth, lightning arcs crackling off it.

name: Explosion
desc: A ground blast: a white flash and shock rings, fire that cools into a rolling smoke column, sparks, burning brands that land and keep burning, tumbling rocks and a glowing scorch.

name: Smoke bomb
desc: A round canister clinks down, fuse sparking, and pops: thick grey-violet smoke gushes out, rolls along the floor, billows into a cloud that hides all, then thins to wisps.

name: Brazier
desc: An iron bowl on a tripod heaped with glowing coals and a big roaring fire, sparks and embers streaming up off it, light on the iron and the floor.

name: Campfire
desc: Crossed logs on a bed of coals and a lively fire: tongues that lick and leap, popping sparks, embers drifting up, smoke curling off, a warm pool of light.

name: Candle
desc: A wax candle in a brass dish: a calm flame with a blue root that sways and stretches, a halo of light, motes drifting in it, a bead of wax running down a drip.

name: Fire breath
desc: A roaring cone of fire streaming right from the mouth: white-hot at the lips, billowing out and cooling to red and smoke at its edges, sparks thrown out ahead.

name: Fire ring
desc: A white flash at the feet, then flames race outward along the floor in a ring, flaring as the front passes and burning down behind it over a smouldering scorch.

name: Fire tornado
desc: A spinning funnel of fire: spiral bands turning round it, licks flung off its sides, a ring of flame whirling at its foot, embers orbiting it in and out of view.

name: Fireball
desc: A fireball flying right: a churning white-hot head with a corona of flame, a long torn tail of flame puffs cooling into smoke, embers shed behind.

name: Flame pillar
desc: The floor cracks and glows, a column of fire erupts white-hot and roars, spewing embers and shedding flame, then collapses into rolling smoke.

name: Flamethrower
desc: A pressurised jet shooting right: a blue pilot at the nozzle, a tight stream with surges racing down it, a sputter, burning drops falling off, a tip that curls up into smoke.

name: Meteor
desc: A burning rock streaks in from the upper left in a comet of fire and smashes into the floor: a white flash, a fireball, rocks and brands thrown, a glowing crater that cools.

name: Spirit flame
desc: A cold blue-teal ghost fire floating in the air: a bright rim round a hollow dark heart, a wave climbing its wispy tail, curls breaking off, cold sparks rising.

name: Torch
desc: A wall torch on an iron bracket: a licking flame leaping off a pitch-soaked wrap, licks and puffs torn off its tips, smoke, embers, a flickering light on the wall.

name: Blessing
desc: A soft cone of light rests on the character from above; sparkles drift down through it, twinkling, and wink out where they land on the head and shoulders.

name: Divine shield
desc: A bubble of gold light round the character: a bright rim and a thin gold film, meridians turning like a slow globe, a sheen sweeping across and sparkles winking on it.

name: Feather burst
desc: A white puff pops and throws feathers that brake hard, then rock from side to side as they sink and fade, with down drifting after them.

name: Halo
desc: A ring of gold light floats over the head with a glint running round it; fine dust sifts down from it and the head catches its light.

name: Healing ring
desc: A seed of green light sinks into the floor and a soft ring rolls out from it; the floor glows where it passes and plus signs sprout and float up.

name: Heal
desc: Petals of light bloom under the feet, a hoop of light rises up the body restoring its colour and leaving sparkles, and motes spiral up and pop into tiny hearts.

name: Holy pillar
desc: Light breaks through from above: a sun opens at the top and a fan of shafts converges on the mark, pulsing, while a sigil burns on the floor; then the fan folds shut.

name: Resurrection
desc: Light pours down on the fallen and life climbs back up the body; wings of light unfold, a halo forms, one great wingbeat, then the wings scatter into feathers.

name: Smite
desc: A glint marks the spot, then a bolt of light drops like a hammer: a white flash, a shockwave over the floor, stone chips flying and cracks that glow and cool.

name: Sunburst
desc: A white-hot core in a gold corona; long and short rays turn slowly round it, breathing, with glints running out along them that wink at the tips.

name: Blizzard vortex
desc: A swirling snow tornado: wind bands spin up a leaning funnel, flakes and ice crystals orbit in front and behind, snow boils at its foot and cold light fills its throat.

name: Freeze
desc: Frost races in and climbs the character, turning it to ice; a faceted block crystallizes round it pane by pane, glints, cracks and bursts, and the character thaws free.

name: Frost breath
desc: A cone of icy wind blowing right: frost puffs billow out, swell and sink, wind streaks race through, ice crystals tumble and glint off a white-hot mouth.

name: Frost nova
desc: Frost spirals into a spinning snowflake, then a wave blooms three rings of ice crystals round the caster; snow drifts, frost creeps, and the ice melts back into the floor.

name: Ice crystal
desc: A floating ice crystal turning slowly in its own cold light: its facets brighten and darken as they turn, glints flash on them, frost motes circle it.

name: Ice lance
desc: A faceted ice spear flying right: a light pulse runs through its core, rings of cold air shear off the tip, frost peels off into a wake and crystals shed behind it.

name: Ice shatter
desc: A block of ice takes a hit from the left: it jolts, cracks race over its faces, it flashes white and bursts into chunks that tumble, bounce and skid off in a roll of ice dust.

name: Ice spikes
desc: A frost line races along the floor and clusters of jagged ice blades burst up behind it in a rising wave, glint, flash white together and shatter into toppling shards.

name: Icicle fall
desc: An icicle drips and trembles, snaps off its frosted root, drops, stabs the floor and bursts into skidding shards, splinters and rolling frost.

name: Snowflake burst
desc: A cold pop: frost gathers and flashes white in a ring, then crisp six-armed snowflakes spin out, slow, twinkle and drift down to settle and melt.

name: Blunt hit
desc: A heavy, soft thud: a white-hot lumpy blob cools to cream in a warm pool of light, inked wedges jab out and snap back, a squashed ring of dust puffs swells and drifts, clods drop.

name: Bullet impact
desc: A bullet hits a wall on the right: a hot half-star, sparks sprayed back in a cone, a puff of grit, chips that fall and bounce, a pock mark cooling to soot.

name: Critical hit
desc: A critical hit: a jagged starburst slams in white and overshoots, a ring breaks into flying arcs, sparks streak off, shards tumble to the floor under a big flare.

name: Ground slam
desc: Something lands hard: the floor flashes and cracks, two crescent shock waves race out along it, a dust wave and a tall dust cloud rise, rocks erupt, bounce and settle.

name: Heavy landing
desc: A character lands hard: the floor dents and cracks under their feet, two rings of dust roll out along the floor one after the other, and pebbles hop away.

name: Hit flash
desc: The character takes damage: a white frame, then their own colors flushed red and blinking white, cooling off, while comic hit lines jab in at them.

name: Hit spark
desc: The everyday hit: a sharp, lopsided cross flare with one long ray along the blow round a white diamond core, then a cone of sparks and hot chips that fall and bounce.

name: Impact frame
desc: An anime impact: two frames of white with black burst lines rushing at the hit, two frames inverted, then the lines pull out past the edges and vanish.

name: Parry
desc: Two blades clash: their edges flash in an X, a white four-point star rings out, a ring breaks into arcs and a fan of gold sparks sprays up and rains down.

name: Ricochet
desc: A tracer streaks down onto the floor, glances off with a white-hot star and skips away at an angle, leaving a glowing skid while sparks skitter along the ground.

name: Shield block
desc: A blow is caught on a half-dome of energy in front of the character: its diamond lattice flashes, a ripple runs over it, sparks glance off, then it blinks out cell by cell.

name: Ball lightning
desc: A crackling ball of plasma drifts on a wandering loop, spitting arcs off its skin and leaving a wake of fading motes, and zaps the floor when it dips low.

name: Chain lightning
desc: A bolt leaps from the caster's hand through three targets in turn; each flashes, sparks and grounds itself to the floor while the arcs between them flicker, then the chain snaps.

name: Charge up
desc: Sparks streak and arcs whip in to a crackling core at the caster's hand that swells and pulses faster, then it flashes and bursts: bolts every way, a ring, a spray of sparks.

name: Electrified
desc: Current runs through a character: arcs crawl over and leap across the body, sparks spit off, the body flares to an electric silhouette on each jolt, and the feet ground out.

name: Lightning strike
desc: A targeted strike: a sigil charges on the floor, the scene darkens, a thick bolt slams into it, arcs race out along the cracks it splits, the channel crumbles to a scorch.

name: Plasma ball
desc: A glass globe on a dark pedestal: wandering plasma tendrils reach from the core to the glass and fan out in bright feet where they touch it, lighting the stand and floor.

name: Spark arc
desc: A climbing arc between two rods: it strikes white at their narrow foot, climbs on rising heat as it stretches and bows, sputters and snaps at the top, then strikes again.

name: Storm cloud
desc: A storm cloud boils overhead, billows lit from inside by flickering discharges, ragged scud under its flat dark base; rain slants down and once a loop a bolt cracks to the floor.

name: Tesla coil
desc: A copper coil under a steel torus throws branching arcs that lash out in volleys and now and then strike the floor in a spray of sparks, lighting the metal and the ground.

name: Thunderclap
desc: A thunderclap round the caster: a white flash, forked bolts burst out and stab the floor, a heavy shock ring tears across the ground raising dust and grit, sparks streak away.

name: Zap hit
desc: A contact zap: an arc snaps in from the left, the hit point overloads into a knot of tiny crackling zigzags, a fern of burn marks glows outward, sparks jink away, ozone puffs.

name: Claw swipe
desc: Three claw marks rake down one after another, white-hot, cooling through orange to red, then close up from both ends and leave a dotted scar, with hot flecks and drips.

name: Dagger flurry
desc: A flurry of small quick crescents at every angle in front of the fighter, each with a flick of sparks, finished by one big cut that glints and bursts.

name: Double slash
desc: A down cut, then an up cut that crosses it: the moment the X closes both strokes flash white, the crossing bursts with light and sparks, and a dotted X lingers.

name: Hammer smash
desc: A hammer drops in front in a wedge of motion: a white slam with rays, a dome of force, a dent with cracks, rocks thrown up that bounce and settle, and dust.

name: Heavy cleave
desc: A glint over the head, then a thick ember arc accelerates over the top into the floor: a white slam, glowing cracks, dust rolling both ways, grit and rising embers.

name: Scythe reap
desc: A slow, huge dark crescent reaps round the front with a pale ghostly edge; it hangs, then tears away from the tail into curling wisps and cold vapour.

name: Spear sweep
desc: A wide low sweep at shin height: a long flat crescent swings from behind the legs round the front, and the wind of it kicks a wake of dust and grit along the floor.

name: Spin slash
desc: The blade whirls once round the waist on a tilted plane, behind the body and back in front; the closed ring flares white, dissolves into a dotted trace and throws sparks.

name: Sword slash
desc: A tilted crescent whips round in two frames, cools from white to deep blue as it trails off, glints at the tip and throws sparks.

name: Thrust
desc: A piercing stab: a bundle of streaks shoots out from the hand to a point, a long four-point star flares at the tip with a pierce ring, sparks and speed lines.

name: Uppercut
desc: A crescent rises from the floor past the face, and at the top a comic impact star bursts: bold outline, hot core, burst lines, twinkles and sparks.

name: Whip crack
desc: A whip rolls out to the right as a loop running down its length, faster and faster, until the tip flips over and cracks: a white pop, a ring of air, sparks and a puff of smoke.

name: Arrow shot
desc: He raises the bow, draws to his cheek, holds his breath and looses: the string snaps forward, the arrow crosses the floor and thuds home.

name: Dash strike
desc: A crouch, then he's across the floor in a blur of after-images and already cutting: a critical hit, a beat, and he hops back to where he started.

name: Earth stomp
desc: A knee comes up, the boot slams down, the floor heaves under the target and a stone spike rams up through it.

name: Fireball throw
desc: He gathers fire in his hand, leans back and hurls it: the ball flies, the target takes it in a blast and comes out charred.

name: Ground pound
desc: He coils, leaps out of frame height, hangs, and comes down like a rock: the floor cracks, shock waves race out and throw the target about as they pass.

name: Holy smite
desc: Both hands go up and a glint marks the target; he brings them down and a bolt of light drops like a hammer, leaving the target blanched.

name: Ice lance throw
desc: Frost gathers into a spear in his hand, he throws it like a javelin, and the target ices over in a burst of snowflakes and shivers.

name: Lightning call
desc: An arm goes up, a sigil lights under the target, and on the downswing a thick bolt comes down on it; the target jolts through the aftershocks.

name: Meteor call
desc: A long chant: a circle draws itself round him, it flares, he points, and a burning rock comes down on the target and flattens the scene.

name: Pistol shots
desc: Three aimed shots: the gun kicks up each time and settles, tracers cross the floor, and the target staggers under each hit.

name: Rocket launcher
desc: He drops to one knee, shoulders the tube and fires: the kick shoves him back along the floor, the rocket crawls out on its jet and the target goes up.

name: Sword combo
desc: Three strokes walking forward: a slash, a crossing double cut, and a two-handed cleave into the floor that throws the target about.

name: Acid splash
desc: A gob of acid bursts into a crown and spatters; it eats a glowing, smoking pit into the floor and boils down into it, spitting bright beads, pale steam curling off.

name: Boulder
desc: A spinning boulder arcs right shedding dust and pebbles, smashes into the floor in a white flash and bursts into tumbling chunks, gravel and rolling dust.

name: Earth spike
desc: The floor cracks with light and heaves, a faceted stone spike rams up with two side shards in a burst of chips, grit and dust; rubble rains, then it splits and crumbles.

name: Healing bloom
desc: A sprout pushes up and unfurls, a bud swells and opens round a glowing golden heart in a flare of healing light; its petals lift away one by one as motes.

name: Leaf storm
desc: Leaves tumble up a rising spiral round the character, passing behind and in front, turning and flipping, wrapped in bright bands of wind; litter swirls at their feet.

name: Poison cloud
desc: A miasma hugging the floor: ragged sheets of gas lit yellow-green from within, fading to violet, creep out in tongues that curl over at their tips; plumes twist up as ribbons.

name: Quake
desc: The ground jolts three times: a rift tears out along the floor glowing deep inside, slabs of floor heave up and drop back askew, pebbles hop and dust bursts out of the split.

name: Root snare
desc: The floor cracks and roots burst up round the character, spiralling round its legs; they cinch tight with a snap, hold, then crack and crumble into bark and dust.

name: Spore burst
desc: A toadstool pushes up, swells and trembles as its gills glow, then squashes and puffs a lumpy cloud of glowing spores that billows up and drifts down twinkling.

name: Thorns
desc: A seam races along the floor and hooked thorns punch up out of it one after another, each bigger than the last, in bursts of dirt and green light; they hold, then sink.

name: Tornado
desc: A snaking funnel of spinning wind bands under a flared, churning top that flickers with lightning; leaves and debris whirl round it front and back, dust boils at its foot.

name: Toxic puddle
desc: Black tar lit from inside by chartreuse veins and a glowing rim, an oily sheen drifting on it; glossy bubbles dome, stretch and pop, vapour curls up in fraying ribbons.

name: Vine whip
desc: A thorny vine bursts from the floor, rears back coiled, then lashes out right in a whip crack that sprays sap and tears off leaves, before sliding back into the ground.

name: Chest open
desc: A banded chest rattles with gold light leaking from its seam, the lid kicks open, rays fan up, and coins and gems arc out, bounce, glint and get collected.

name: Coin spin
desc: A thick gold coin turning on its edge: an embossed star face, a reeded rim showing as it goes edge-on, a flash sweeping the face, bobbing over its shadow.

name: Collect burst
desc: The moment of pickup: a white flash and a cross of light, a thin ring snapping out ahead of a softer one, twinkles thrown wide on curving paths that brake, hang and wink out.

name: Crystal shard
desc: A broken amber shard hovers and sways: chipped uneven faces, its top sheared off, light pulsing up through glowing cracks and flaring out of the break; splinters orbit it.

name: Gem spin
desc: A brilliant-cut ruby turning on its axis: real facets catch the light in turn, flashes roll over the crown, refracted light slides across the floor, sparkles wink round it.

name: Heart pickup
desc: A plump glossy heart hovering over its shadow beats lub-dub: a big squash and stretch, a smaller echo, light and a thin ring pulsing out, tiny hearts drifting off.

name: Key glint
desc: An ornate silver key hovering and rocking; a glint runs from its bow down the shaft to the teeth and bursts off the tip as falling sparks.

name: Loot beam
desc: A dropped sword in a tall pillar of rarity light: a white core thinning to the sky, rings pulsing across the floor, motes streaming up, a glint racing up the shaft.

name: Potion
desc: A round glass flask of glowing brew rocks in the air: the brew sloshes behind the rock, bubbles rise and pop, light glows through the glass, wisps curl off the cork.

name: Power star
desc: A fat bevelled star rocks side to side and swells on each beat, rays of light turning slowly behind it, sparks spinning off its points.

name: XP orb
desc: A small glowing orb races a figure-eight, a comet tail tapering behind it along its path, flecks shed from the tail winking out, its light following it over the floor.

name: Arrow
desc: An arrow in flight: a steel broadhead catching the light, a wooden shaft, fletching fluttering in the wind, streaks of air peeling off its head and swirling off its feathers.

name: Bullet tracer
desc: A white-hot slug tearing along, its tracer burning behind it in a long streak that sputters and cools from white through gold to red, shedding sparks and a thread of smoke.

name: Cannon shot
desc: A cannon fires from a muzzle `height` px above the floor (the origin): a white flash, a tongue of flame, the ball arcing off trailing smoke, a big gunsmoke cloud rolling out.

name: Energy disc
desc: A sawblade of crackling energy spinning flat out as it flies: hooked teeth bright on their leading edges, a white hub, spiral arms churning, sparks flung off the teeth.

name: Signal flare
desc: A signal flare streaks up off the ground trailing sparks and smoke, bursts, and hangs as a pulsing red star that drips sparks under its own red-lit smoke, then gutters out.

name: Homing missile
desc: A missile kicks off, arcs up, rolls over and dives onto its target (the origin), its smoke trail left hanging in the air, and hits in a fiery blast of flame, sparks and rocks.

name: Laser bolt
desc: A red laser bolt: a white-hot core in a rounded head, red bands tapering back, pulses racing down it, a tail that shimmers apart into wavering dashes.

name: Magic missile
desc: Motes gather into an arcane orb at a hand `height` px above the floor (the origin); it weaves to its target trailing a twisting ribbon and bursts into a star of light.

name: Pistol shot
desc: One pistol shot from a muzzle `height` px above the floor (the origin): a spiky white-cored flash, sparks, a curl of smoke hooking up and back, a casing that bounces and settles.

name: Shotgun blast
desc: A shotgun blast from a muzzle `height` px above the floor (the origin): a wide ragged fan of flame, pellet streaks, a heavy rolling smoke cloud, a red shell kicked out on the pump.

name: SMG burst
desc: Sustained fire at twelve rounds a second: each shot a different spiky flash with a white core, sparks, smoke wisps piling up and drifting, brass casings bouncing on the floor.

name: Plasma shot
desc: A glowing plasma blob: hot knots churning in its core, a corona crackling over its skin, its tail necking into droplets that tear off, cool and wink out behind.

name: Rocket
desc: A steel rocket roars along: a flickering jet with shock diamonds and a white-hot nozzle, a thick billowing smoke trail lit by the flame, sparks shed behind.

name: EMP blast
desc: A disc charge ticks, pops white, and a bubble of rolling scanlines swells out with arcs crawling its skin; it strobes, tears and shorts out into falling dead pixels.

name: Energy core
desc: A plasma core beating in a steel cage: it swells and throws a shock ring on each beat, two tilted rings orbit it, and arcs jump to the bars and spark.

name: Force field
desc: A glassy dome of hex plates over the hero: plates glint, tracers from the right slam into it, a ripple and cracks of light race across, sparks glance off.

name: Glitch
desc: The hero's signal breaks up in bursts: an RGB split, slices torn sideways, rows smeared out, junk blocks and dead pixels, then snaps back clean.

name: Hologram
desc: A floor projector throws a cone of light holding a turning wireframe model: scanlines roll through it, a data ring circles it, and it flickers, tears and jitters.

name: Jetpack
desc: Twin thrusters fire straight down: white-hot cores with shock diamonds inside ragged flames, puffs that cool into smoke billowing below, lit by the fire.

name: Laser grid
desc: Security lasers between two steel posts: red beams slide and scissor across, dust and haze light up only where they cut through, and the floor sweepers scorch and spark.

name: Scanner
desc: Brackets snap onto the hero, a scan line sweeps head to toe leaving a cooling outline, and a readout counts up to OK before it all lets go.

name: Teleporter pad
desc: A steel pad glows on the floor, its rings rippling outward; a soft column of light rises off it and rings of light lift away, sparkles drifting up through them.

name: Tractor beam
desc: A hovering pod projects a cone of light to the floor; rocks tear loose in puffs of dust and spiral up spinning into the lens while rings of light climb the beam.

name: Warp in
desc: A beam slams down, rings run down it and a scanline paints the hero in from head to toe, white-hot pixels cooling to their own colors; the beam pinches shut in sparks.

name: Warp out
desc: The hero's outline flickers on, they flash white and break into light from the head down, streaming up a beam that lifts off the floor and pinches shut.

name: Black hole
desc: A tilted disk of banded rings turns round a black hole, its far side bent up over the top and under the bottom; debris spirals in, stretches and is swallowed.

name: Curse
desc: Wisps gather over the head, a skull stamps down with a flash, its eyes burn as the curse floods the body violet, then it cracks and crumbles.

name: Dark explosion
desc: Motes swirl into a pulsing core, a black star cuts across a violet-white flash, and a black sphere burns at the rim, throws lit shards and smoke, then collapses.

name: Eclipse
desc: A black moon over the sun: a breathing pearl corona with long streamers, a thin white rim, and one diamond bead blazing on its edge.

name: Grasping hands
desc: Shadow arms burst up out of a dark pool with a splash, clench their hands into claws, strain, and are dragged back under, fingers clawing at the air.

name: Hex sigil
desc: A burning pen traces a cursed sigil in the air, its glyphs pop in one by one, then it flares white and crumbles into falling embers.

name: Life steal
desc: A target on the right is struck and bleeds red orbs; they hang a moment, then whip home as comet streaks and flood the caster crimson.

name: Necro skulls
desc: Spectral skulls circle a cold green flame on a tilted orbit, passing behind and before it, eyes lit, trailing curls of ghost smoke.

name: Shadow flames
desc: Inside-out fire on the floor: a black heart wrapped in violet flame with pale skin and tips, shedding embers and dark smoke.

name: Shadow tendrils
desc: A dark pool opens on the floor; tentacles with lit rims and hooked tips lash up out of it with a splash, writhe, and sink back as it closes.

name: Soul drain
desc: Pale souls are torn loose on the right and dragged down a funnel of streaks into a black crystal vessel, which flares violet as each one lands.

name: Void orb
desc: A black orb hangs in the air, a pale rim crawling round it; a dark vortex winds into it, motes and streaks are pulled in, and light bends round its edge.

name: Coin drop
desc: An enemy goes up in a soft poof and gold coins spin out of it, bounce with a glint on each hit, settle on the floor, twinkle, and wink out one by one.

name: Disintegrate
desc: The character crackles with light, flashes white, then peels away from the head down: each pixel flares white-hot and streams off on the wind as a cooling mote of light.

name: Dissolve burn
desc: An ember seam lights at the feet and climbs the body: above it the body scorches and smoulders, at it flames lick up, below it there's only falling ash, embers and smoke.

name: Egg hatch
desc: A speckled egg rocks three times, each rock cracking it further with warm light leaking out, then pops: light pours out of the opening and lit shell halves tumble away.

name: Poof
desc: A cartoon death poof: a white pop, a ring of soft round smoke balls bursting out between speed lines, little stars spinning off, and the cloud lifting and thinning away.

name: Respawn beam
desc: A guide line drops, a pillar of light slams onto the spot, and a scan bar climbs from the feet writing the character back in row by row, white-hot lines cooling to its colors.

name: Shatter death
desc: Frost races up the body and seals it in faceted ice, a glint sweeps it, cracks spread from the chest, then it bursts into its own facets that tumble, bounce and melt.

name: Soul rise
desc: The body's outline flares and dims, then a pale glowing copy of it lifts out, stretching as its legs melt into a rippling wisp, shedding motes until it thins into light.

name: Spawn portal
desc: A rift tears open on the floor and swirls, belches violet smoke and sparks, spits a fountain of wisps up out of itself, then twists shut with a pop.

name: Summon rise
desc: A rune circle burns into the floor, the ground bursts, and a horned brute heaves up out of it through dust and rubble, lit from below, until its eyes flare.

name: Bleeding
desc: Bleeding out: beads swell at three wounds, run, let go and fall to spatter into a glossy pool that ripples; each heartbeat spurts a little and flashes the body red.

name: Burning
desc: Burning over time: small flames lick from four hot spots, trailing sparks and thin smoke; every 0.6 s they flare, the body flashes white then orange, scorch marks spread.

name: Charmed
desc: Smitten: a big heart beats over the head, throwing a ring and a flush of light with every beat, little hearts float up, the eyes go pink and the cheeks blush.

name: Confused
desc: Head in a spin: a glowing spiral whirls over the head, question marks pop up round it and bob, the eyes dart left and right.

name: Cursed
desc: Hexed: violet smoke rises off the body in winding trails, a dark stain creeps up from the feet with a glowing edge, the eyes burn, a skull glitches in overhead.

name: Frozen
desc: Chilled to the bone: frost ferns creep over the body, icicles hang from chin and hands and drip, breath steams, snow settles, a shiver every second, frost spreads underfoot.

name: Haste
desc: Sped up: striped after-images stream out behind, speed lines whip past, dust kicks off the heels and the leading edge catches the wind. Faces right.

name: Petrified
desc: Turned to stone: grey creeps up from the feet behind a crackling edge that spits grit, the statue holds, cracks run through it, and it bursts into tumbling chunks and dust.

name: Poisoned
desc: Sick to the bone: green rolls up the body in waves, dark veins creep from a wound, toxic sweat drips and hisses; every 0.8 s it wobbles, blisters pop and a ring pulses out.

name: Rage
desc: Seething: the body judders on every heartbeat, an anger mark throbs at the temple, eyes burn, steam jets off the head, stress lines flash out and the floor cracks hot underfoot.

name: Sleep
desc: Fast asleep: eyes shut, soft outlined Zs float up off the head one after another, swaying and growing as they rise, dream motes drift, a slow breathing glow.

name: Slowed
desc: Dragged through time: a glassy clock dial behind the head ticks round in heavy steps, flashing with each, while drops sink in slow motion and spread slow rings.

name: Stunned
desc: Seeing stars: three spinning stars and two little birds circle the head on a tilted ring, ducking behind it and sweeping round in front, trailing glitter.

name: Blinds
desc: Slats catch the light edge-on, then tilt shut top to bottom, lit rims glinting as warm light squeezes through the closing gaps with dust in it; then they tilt open and fade.

name: Burn away
desc: The screen burns in from its edges behind a ragged ember line of licking flames, embers and smoke; then the black smoulders and burns open from the middle.

name: CRT off
desc: The picture squeezes into a white-hot glowing line, the line into a dot that lingers as a fading afterglow; then it switches back on, dot to line to picture, with a warm-up glow.

name: Diamond wipe
desc: A wave of faceted diamonds swells across the screen, rims bright and ridges lit, cooling to black as they lock; then they rise as gems again and shrink away with glints.

name: Glitch wipe
desc: Torn bands of black stutter across the screen, freezing and jerking back, their ragged edges split into magenta and cyan ghosts spitting data slivers; then they tear on through.

name: Iris
desc: A lit iris closes onto a warm spotlight where dust drifts, holds as its rim twinkles, snaps shut into a glint, then pops open from a flash with a white-hot rim throwing sparks.

name: Pixel dissolve
desc: Clumps of blocks wink in, each drawn in a white outline that fills black and cools, with glints; then they wink out, outlines collapsing, the last small ones sparkling away.

name: Shatter wipe
desc: A dark glass pane drops over the screen and bounces; cracks race out from an impact with a flash, then it bursts into tumbling glass shards with lit edges that fall away.

name: Slash wipe
desc: A white-hot blade edge slices across the screen, light ahead of it and sparks spraying back over the cover; a second cut flashes through and the cover splits apart.

name: Star iris
desc: A five-point star iris spins shut on the middle of the screen, its gold rim lit and its tips twinkling and shedding motes; it closes on a glint and spins open again from a flash.

name: Achievement
desc: A toast slides in on speed lines and settles; a gold medal pops onto it in a burst of sparkles, a shine sweeps the whole toast, then it slides away.

name: Coin collect
desc: A coin bursts into a fountain of spinning coins that hang, then zip one by one into a HUD counter that pops and ticks up, glints and folds away.

name: Combo counter
desc: x5 COMBO rockets in on streaming speed lines, smearing, and slams to a stop: a white flash, a ring, sparks; it pulses while a timer bar drains, then whooshes out.

name: Confetti
desc: Two party poppers bang one after the other: paper bits and curly streamers burst out, stall, then tumble and flutter down, flipping, and settle on the floor.

name: Countdown
desc: 3, 2, 1 slam into a timer ring that drains like a burning fuse, throwing sparks; then GO! bursts out as the ring blows into a shockwave with rays.

name: Crit number
desc: CRIT 128! slams in huge and white over a jagged starburst with a hard shake and speed lines, cools to fire, holds with a shine, then pops into sparks.

name: Damage number
desc: A red -27 punches out of a hit spark, white for a frame, arcs up, lands with a squash and a little hop, then fades as it lifts away.

name: Exclamation
desc: A bold ! springs up off the hero's head, stretching as it shoots up and squashing as it lands; surprise ticks flick out, it wobbles, then pops away.

name: Health bar hit
desc: A segmented health bar takes a hit: it jolts and dips, the lost chunk flashes white and sheds chips, holds, then drains away behind a sparking edge.

name: Heart lost
desc: A HUD heart is hit: it flashes white and jolts, a crack runs down it, it splits into two halves that tumble away, leaving an empty socket that fades.

name: Level up
desc: Gold gathers at the feet and bursts up as a pillar of light round the hero; rings climb it, LEVEL UP! drops in letter by letter, a shine sweeps it, sparkles twinkle.

name: Quest complete
desc: A stitched ribbon unrolls from the middle, QUEST COMPLETE types on letter by letter, a gold seal stamps down and ticks, stars pop; then it all rolls away.

name: Bubbles
desc: Bubbles stream up from a vent of pebbles, wobbling and swelling as they rise, flare as they cross shafts of light from the surface, then dome up and pop there.

name: Drip
desc: A bead swells under a wet stone tip and catches the light, pinches off, falls stretched by its speed and plinks into a puddle with a crown, a ring and a tiny rebound.

name: Fountain
desc: A stone basin; a jet rises from its spout and blooms into glassy arcs that break into beads, fall back and plink into the water with rings.

name: Geyser
desc: A pool heaves and burbles faster and faster, then blasts a white column of water skyward with a churning foam head; it rains back down in drops and steam, slumps and sputters out.

name: Rain splash
desc: A low close-up on one puddle in the rain: big drops land in crowns that throw beads and a rebound jet, rings spread and interfere, a lamp's reflection wobbles on the water.

name: Ripples
desc: A drop plinks on still dark water and rings spread out across it at a low angle: the swell of each ring catches the light, crests glint, and they fade into the calm.

name: Splash
desc: A stone drops into still water: a white hit, a crown that tears into droplets arcing out to plink down with rings, a jet that bounces back, foam and drifting mist.

name: Water jet
desc: A pressurised stream blasts right: a tight glassy rod with surges running down it that swells, roughens, bends under its weight and breaks into chunks, spray and mist.

name: Water orb
desc: A sphere of water floats and wobbles: a current circles inside it, the floor shows upside down through it, it shines, light gathers on the floor under it, and drips fall and plink.

name: Waterfall
desc: A river pours from a notch in a rock outcrop: a white curl, a deep sheet that splits into strands, churning foam, spray, drifting mist and rings on a dark pool.

name: Wave crash
desc: A swell rolls in and steepens, its lip throws forward and curls over a dark barrel, then crashes into a burst of white foam and spray that surges on and fades to lace.

name: Whirlpool
desc: Seen from above, dark water winds into a vortex: foam arms spiral in, darkening as they're drawn down into a deep eye with a lit far rim, flecks of foam circling in after them.

name: Aurora
desc: Rippling curtains of green-to-violet light over a starfield: folding hems burn bright, rays shimmer up into violet, and the whole sky slowly breathes.

name: Blizzard
desc: Snow driven almost flat by a gale: streaks at three depths race past, gusts throw translucent sheets of snow across the sky and spindrift streams off the drifts.

name: Cherry blossoms
desc: Pink petals flutter down on a spring breeze, tumbling in little spirals and flashing as they catch the light, with a few whole blossoms spinning among them.

name: Clouds
desc: Layers of clouds drift past a bright moon at night: silver-lit tops, dark bellies, edges that flare where they cross the moon, forming and thinning as they go.

name: Falling leaves
desc: Autumn leaves swing down through the air, tilting and flipping to show their pale backs, ride a gust, land flat in the litter and fade.

name: Fireflies
desc: Fireflies wander over a meadow at night, each glowing up and fading on its own rhythm, trailing light and lighting the grass tips beneath them.

name: Fog
desc: Slow banks of moonlit fog at three depths drift past each other, crests catching the light, while thin streaks of mist slide by in front.

name: God rays
desc: Shafts of light slant down from high on the left, breathing and swaying, pooling on the floor, as drifting dust motes light up whenever they cross a beam.

name: Rain
desc: Slanted rain at four depths: far drops fade into the dark, near ones glint and splash, drops ring the puddles and a low mist drifts over the wet floor.

name: Shooting stars
desc: Meteors burn across a starry sky, white heads trailing gold and rose; the big ones flare and break up, and each leaves a glowing train that twists and fades.

name: Snow
desc: Snow at three depths in a gusty breeze: far specks, drifting flakes, big near crystals that spin and glow; they settle on a sparkling drift and melt away.

name: Storm
desc: Driving rain at two depths under a churning cloud deck; a forked bolt strikes in a double flash that lights the sky and the rain, then sheet lightning glows in the clouds.
